title: When the Tryouts Burns
author: Mara Yarrow
blurb: Quentin Coldharbour, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, has spent ten years being so careful it hurts. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
